source_title: In Which Currency Are The Prices Shown

snippets.snippet_text: "Domestika doesn't apply commissions or taxes relating to the exchange rate between currencies. However, your bank or payment processor may add an additional fee and so we suggest that you contact them directly to confirm their policy regarding this."

"Upon completing your purchase, we will send you the corresponding receipt showing the price in your local currency. If you want to download an invoice, the price will appear in US dollars, consistent with the currency in which you were charged."
